# OpsFlow Advisory

> Supply chain advisory based in Nyon, Switzerland, working with manufacturers and distributors across Europe.
> We build the supply chain strategy with the client and a senior leader stays with the team to make it happen.
> Scope: S&OP / IBP, supply planning, order management and logistics.
> AI-assisted analysis; the judgement and the recommendations stay with senior people.
> Embedded leadership, not an embedded team.
